reviews.text: I received a $10 charge without notice. I also cancelled and it continued to charge. Scam app.

reviews.title: Update/cleared lists
reviews.text: What just happened? The update cleared all of my lists, and acted as if I’m a new user! Everything is gone?!?! I’ve used this app for years!

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Horrible UI, can't change or remove default options. Zero stars.

reviews.title: Customer service is terrible
reviews.text:
1. Besides the response time, customer service agents were absolutely rude and were extremely unhelpful in resolving my issue.
 2. There are so many better apps out there. I'd highly not recommend subscribing to Any.do. To Doist is superior to this app. I'm really frustrated with the customer service.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Not worth the $, glitches require you to reinstall app (which I had to do multiple times) and the support sucks; all they do is make excuses. I cannot get my money back. Don’t waste yours.

reviews.title: Poor upgrades to app
reviews.text: I used to use it and recommend it to my patients with memory issues, but lately I hate it.   It’s too cumbersome and it drives me crazy that if I just enter a task without a specific time it reminds me immediately after entering the task.   If I just entered it, I don’t need to be reminded 10 seconds later.

reviews.title: Problème de bug
reviews.text: Plus accès à mes données!!

reviews.title: Deletes reminders and details
reviews.text: Works great until you try to use it on both desktop and mobile app— it doesn’t properly sync so you’ll lose reminders. Also, sometimes I’ll set a reminder for a future time/date and a few minutes later, it’ll revert to the current/day/time. The bug that really pushed me to write this review though was that, likely due to some update, ALL of my subtasks for ALL of my reminders that has subtasks are GONE. Absolutely tons of routines and data are completely gone now. Horrible and disappointing.

reviews.title: Keeps notifying me—of nothing!
reviews.text: This app is a joke. It pops up a notice, I open the app, and—voila! Nothing to see here, folks. All I want is a reminder of a task that’s due because i-Calendar stopped doing anything but giving a tiny beep at 9am. In the last two years I’ve missed several important dates. If I’m not in the room, too bad. With Any.do, I might as well just make myself check my calendar every day in spite of there being possibly 20 events at most I need to attend to on time annually. I want a refund!

reviews.title: Horrible la dernière version
reviews.text: Sans rien demander, il force a creer un compte et supprime toutes vos données. J’ai perdu toutes mes listes en faisant la mise a jour.

reviews.title: Widget is useless
reviews.text: Widget doesn’t update so all you see is the last day that you actually looked at. Insanely useless, shockingly disappointing. Every other calendar app had this feature 10 years ago. Maybe these kids will learn what they’re doing someday.

reviews.title: Newest update is awful
reviews.text: The latest update destroyed the app. Any time I try to add items to various shopping lists it shows up as a blank checkbox under “other”. I’ve deleted the shopping list, uninstalled and reinstalled the app, restarted my phone, and it still won’t show the items I’ve added to my list. Not much I can do with an invisible shopping list…

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text:
It’s a decent app. But the visual craft and layout of everything just feels ancient, like it hasn’t been looked at by a designer in 10 years. 

The developer response is telling: defensive and clueless. If they cared about minimalism, they wouldn’t have ugly gradients from 2006, poor item spacing across the entire app, poorly chosen and inconsistent icons, and ugly backgrounds with no option of customizing them. If they knew anything about real design, they wouldn’t say “design is subjective”. It looks like it was designed by a second semester design intern. 

I don’t have the energy to do a full design crit of the app in an app store review. But this silly developer response was enough for me to stop using the app. They clearly are just coasting at this point and have no desire to make the app better anymore.

reviews.title: Very poor
reviews.text: This planner tricked me into buying a one year subscription. Now it hangs up at every turn. Complete waste of money.

reviews.title: This company is deceptive
reviews.text: They advertise a 7 day free trial but I was charged $59.99 immediately and was unable to obtain a refund. It’s not worth trying this app or supporting this company. Beware.

reviews.title: App doesn’t open
reviews.text: Keep getting spinning circles off and on the last couple weeks, certainly doesn’t help with productivity when you can’t see your to-do list or add to it at the time

reviews.title: Alles gelöscht
reviews.text: Nach einem Update musste ich mich neu anmelden. Danach waren alle meine Einträge unwiederbringlich gelöscht. Das geht gar nicht! NIE WIEDER Any Do!!!

reviews.title: Charged
reviews.text: I was charged out of nowhere, with no email notification! I have not used this app for years and somehow they charged me?? BEWARE

reviews.title: Any.do Website Claims “PERSONAL” = FREE
reviews.text: I thought this might be a good replacement for M/S ToDo particularly since the webpage www.any.do/pricing states clearly:  PERSONAL use if FREE. But as soon as one installs the app, it immediately tries to place in its “premium” mode costing $5/month and does not offer at all the “Personal” use mode

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: No free plan. They force you to create an account so they have your data and then put you behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years to keep lists and info and all of a sudden I went to check something and it is forcing me to create an account. Now I’ve lost everything I’ve been jotting down for years. Not ok Any.do.

reviews.title: Don’t push things I don’t ask for
reviews.text: If you like unrequested notifications that have nothing to do with your to-dos, this is a great app.  One day of using this app and next thing I know - you’re pushing motivational prompts to me.  I never asked for this, I want notifications for things  that need to get done in the app to cut through clutter in my life - and now you’re clogging up my notifications and sending clutter.  You guys can’t help yourselves.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: This app is so poorly codes that the initial signup form breaks. The required name field fails to raise the virtual keyboard to actually type anything.

reviews.title: Signed up for free 7 days trial and was immediately charged for a year
reviews.text: Title says it all

reviews.title: Not intuitive
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and as soon as I opened it for the first time, it was populated with hundreds of items pulled from either notes, or iCal or who knows what but there was no easy way to delete them all and just start from a blank slate. I don’t even know where it pulled them from. If an app is painful to use right from the beginning, I’m out.

reviews.title: Do not use - securty flaw
reviews.text: I can see other tasks in my lists that i did not add, they are from other people. This makes me extremely worried about the security of this app. Do not add and tasks or details of tasks thay may be be confidential. I will be deleting this app as soon as i get a response from the developer.

reviews.text:
Any.do seems to want me to do far more with the app that use a great to do list system- lately I can’t find it after I set the to do list up in the morning 

This is any do’s core service - help!
